source.description: Cambodian BAC II grade-12 exam booklet screenshot, limits section only

exams.subject_km: គណិតវិទ្យា

questions.label: a
questions.technique: ∞-∞ at infinity. Multiply and divide by the conjugate sqrt(x^2+2x+3)+(x+1); the numerator collapses to the constant 2, so the whole expression is 2/[sqrt(x^2+2x+3)+x+1] → 0 as the denominator → ∞.

questions.label: b
questions.technique: 0/0 at x=0. Replace 1-cos^2x with sin^2x (Pythagorean identity), cancel one factor of sin x, leaving -2x/sin x, then apply the standard sinc limit x/sin x → 1.

questions.label: c
questions.technique: 0/0 at x=-pi/2. Factor sin^4x-1=(sin^2x-1)(sin^2x+1)=-(1-sin x)(1+sin x)(sin^2x+1) via difference of squares plus the Pythagorean form. Cancel (1+sin x), leaving -1/[(1-sin x)(sin^2x+1)]; substitute sin(-pi/2)=-1.
